fields.label: Category
fields.note: iCIMS select#jsb_f_position_s (43 options incl. '(All)'); the same 42 categories are published by both portals.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: iCIMS select#jsb_f_location_s. The select's option values are encoded ids (e.g. 13228-13245-Bangalore for IND-KA-Bangalore, 12781-12789-Carlsbad for US-CA-Carlsbad); labels are shown here. The international portal publishes the 5 non-US sites, the US portal the 3 California sites.

notes: maxlinear.com/company/careers links two MaxLinear-branded iCIMS portals (careersus-maxlinear and careersintl-maxlinear). Each search page is a shell around /jobs/search?ss=1&in_iframe=1 with a GET form (form#searchForm) carrying ss=1, in_iframe=1, searchKeyword, searchCategory, searchLocation, searchZip, searchRadius; pagination is ?pr=N&in_iframe=1 and the sort select rewrites to ?mode=redo&pr=0&schemaId=<field>&o=<A|D>&in_iframe=1 (no date option, so no sort is declared). The iCIMS edge answered HTTP 405 Human Verification to plain HTTP from this egress, so the controls and option lists were read from the company-published search markup saved under companies/maxlinear-technologies/source/ (listing-intl-p0.html, listing-us-p0.html). Employment type ('Type') is only a detail-page header field, not a filter.
evidence: https://careersintl-maxlinear.icims.com/jobs/search?ss=1&in_iframe=1 (form#searchForm: searchKeyword text input, select searchCategory 43 options, select searchLocation 6 options)
